name: How long does kitchen molding installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen molding installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Kitchen molding installation typically takes one to three days depending on project size and finish requirements. A straightforward job involving pre-finished trim on standard upper and lower cabinets often wraps up in a single day. Projects requiring scribing to uneven ceilings, multi-piece stacked crown profiles, or custom on-site painting and caulking usually extend into a second or third day. Clearing kitchen counters and removing items stored in upper cabinets before the crew arrives speeds up setup and protects your belongings from dust.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most kitchen molding installations take one to three days, depending on cabinet layout complexity, ceiling evenness, and whether trim requires on-site painting.
